baselineDescription: current deferred multi-issuer candidate, not main
candidateDescription: try one nonblocking advisory admission on the existing base directory after all native clones join; skip optional hints if another hint pass holds it; unchanged clone/hint worker limits, byte caps, full checks and journals
caveats: Local loaded host, not an independent hosted result. All started observations and outliers are retained.

These observations do not resolve the earlier hosted concurrent timeout.
